profile.headline: Frontend Developer III at UWM
profile.summary:
I am a creative, detail-focused, Multimedia Designer and UI/UX Developer, passionate about all forms of design and associated technologies and how they improve the user’s experience and enhance the creative flow. With over 17 years experience in multimedia design and four years in market research, I have created and enhanced company branding and developed cutting-edge marketing collateral across both digital and print mediums for Fortune 500 clients. Whether I am leading a complete website design from concept and testing to launch, or developing SPSS Dimensions surveys and HTML email invites, I help corporate giants communicate with, and market to, their customers. I make sure that the interaction is seamless and enhances the user’s experience. 

I am relentless and tenacious in the pursuit of my goals. It does not matter if I have the experience needed or not. If I don’t know how to do it, I will learn the new technology or methodologies to reach my objective. This determination and commitment to learning has helped me enhance my skills which has established me as the “go-to” person to resolve issues, lead complex design projects, and wow clients. I am sought-after not only for my design talents, but also for my commitment to quality and focus on delivering projects on time and on budget. I have even been able to find solutions to programming problems that programmers could not solve. 

Selected highlights of my career include:

Created the first mobile ready online survey GUI for Loblaws grocery chain which resulted in a $5M account.

Developed a system of proofreading and reviewing projects prior to production which reduced rework and time to completion by 60%.

Redesigned a corporate website and maximized SEO, which improved site traffic by 200%.

positions.title: UX Developer II
positions.description:
As a User Experience Developer I am an advocate for all users and strive to design, develop and test web accessible experiences of United Shore web properties. Working within an agile workflow I'll create wireframes and iterate through designs while working closely with product owners. Implement designs by developing HTML 5 & ADA compliant web applications, using SASS, LESS, JavaScript, ES6, jQuery, MVC and other technologies. 

United Shore is home of the largest wholesale mortgage company in the United States UWM. At UWM we are creating application that make our clients (Mortgage Brokers) the best in the industry.

positions.title: User Interface Designer
positions.description: Designed and developed new engaging internal web applications to replace previous manual processes. Anchored our website redesign team as the UI Designer and Lead Front-end developer using HTML5, CSS3, SASS, Bootstrap and jQuery to ensure our site was ADA compliant, cross-browser friendly and mobile responsive. Designed our upcoming MB Financial Mobile app by iterating through several low and high fidelity wireframes to create a better functional design over our existing app for both Android & iOS devices.

positions.title: Freelance UX Designer, Front-end Web Developer
positions.description: Developed engaging UX Designs and Front-end development using HTML5, CSS3 and jQuery for clients. Ensured that high fidelity mockup’s code and style guidelines where optimized and performed brilliantly for cross-browser compatibility and device responsiveness.

positions.title: Multimedia Specialist, UI/UX Designer, Front-end Developer
positions.description:
Ipsos acquired Synovate in Oct. 2011 

Develop custom HTML mobile enhanced templates, landing pages, and HTML Graphic User Interface (GUI) for SPSS Dimensions surveys, HTML email invites, and mobile responsive and cross-browser HTML UI designs for Fortune 500 corporations including Microsoft, Loblaws, Fidelity, Bank of America, P&G, IHG and Blue Cross Blue Shield. 

Created Ipsos’ first mobile ready survey GUI to retain Canada’s largest grocery chain as a client. Managed the entire development lifecycle from conception to launch in four months. 

Reduced rework and time to completion by 60% through careful review and proofreading of projects upfront and resolving inaccuracies before start of production.

Delivered a critical survey layout change for Microsoft within an extremely tight deadline by leveraging jQuery to dynamically change the HTML survey layout.

Recognized as the Media Production Group’s top producer.

positions.title: Multimedia Specialist
positions.description:
Contracted to Synovate to create customer HTML landing pages, HTML emails, and online survey templates. 

Debranded images, video and audio.

Developed a multimedia knowledgebase posting design best practices

positions.title: Freelance Designer
positions.description:
Managed graphic design and web production projects for advertising and marketing clients, creating new branding and improving existing marketing collateral. 

Assumed sole HTML production project responsibilities eliminating the need for a team of four designers, which reduced cost and increased quality.

positions.title: Senior Graphic/Web/Interactive Designer
positions.description:
Updated, modernized and improved the company’s professional corporate image. 

Redesigned the corporate website, including graphics and coding, to meet web 2.0 standards. Provided cross browser support and maximized SEO, resulting in a dramatic increase of web traffic flow by 200%.

Created new icons for the OBTAIN software program and collaborated with vendors to improve the user’s experience.

positions.title: Freelance Designer
positions.description:
Created 3D renderings, presentation graphics, website designs and implemented code compliancy for cross browser support for clients.  

Gathered information on client needs and advised them on best course of action.

Software & Tools
Photoshop CS2, Illustrator CS2, Flash Pro 8, Dreamweaver 8, Maya 7

positions.title: Production Designer
positions.description:
Led graphic design projects, producing designs that ensured proper visual flow and functionality to adhere to corporate branding standards. 

Developed intranet/kiosk GUI for client training programs. 

Created innovative Flash animations and motion designs for over 100 projects for Fortune 500 companies, including Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, Smart, GM, Cadillac and Michelin.

positions.title: Lead Designer
positions.description:
Analyzed client’s business goals and created designs for web sites and print work. Supported sales team with the development of interactive presentations and sales tools.

Developed a startup company’s brand through the design of all promotional materials, including website development, pamphlets, letterhead, logo, book cover and layout, CD silkscreen, interactive CD, video editing and content creation.

Software & Tools
Photoshop, Flash, Illustrator,  After Effects, Maya, Director, Cool Edit, Final Cut Pro

positions.title: Multimedia/Graphic Designer
positions.description:
Designed interactive multimedia GUI, illustrated designs for poster ads and created 3D animations for video and interactive presentations. Designed company logos for clients and established a branding presence for start-up companies.

Software & Tools
Photoshop , Director, 3D Studio Max, Flash, Cool Edit, Illustrator, Maya
